## Set-Cookie merging map (Serena semantic tools; all line numbers are the 0-based values Serena/LSP returns)

### Core: `Context.res` and the merge logic
All in `src/context.ts`:

| Symbol (name_path) | Kind | Location |
|---|---|---|
| `Context` | Class | `src/context.ts:292-797` |
| `Context/#res` | Property | `src/context.ts:336` |
| `Context/#preparedHeaders` | Property | `src/context.ts:340` |
| `Context/res[0]` (getter) | Method | `src/context.ts:402-406` |
| `Context/res[1]` (setter) | Method | `src/context.ts:413-433` |
| `createResponseInstance` | Constant | `src/context.ts:287-290` |

The merge itself is in `Context/res[1]` (`src/context.ts:413-433`): it rebuilds the incoming response via `createResponseInstance`, skips `content-type`, and for `k === 'set-cookie'` reads `this.#res.headers.getSetCookie()`, deletes the combined `set-cookie` header, then re-`append`s each cookie individually. All other headers use `.set()`.

`Context/res[0]` lazily creates the response using `createResponseInstance(null, { headers: this.#preparedHeaders ??= new Headers() })`.

### Related response/header plumbing in `src/context.ts`
| Symbol | Kind | Location |
|---|---|---|
| `SetHeadersOptions` (`append?: boolean`) | Interface | `src/context.ts:253-255` |
| `SetHeaders` | Interface | `src/context.ts:257-261` |
| `Context/header` | Property (arrow fn) | `src/context.ts:518-531` |
| `Context/#newResponse` | Method | `src/context.ts:608-656` |
| `Context/newResponse` | Property | `src/context.ts:658` |
| `HeaderRecord` | Type alias | `src/context.ts:17-20` |
| `NewResponse` | Interface | `src/context.ts:112-115` |
| `ResponseOrInit` | Type alias | `src/context.ts:276` |

`Context/header` writes to `this.#res.headers` or `#preparedHeaders`, using `headers.append(name, value)` when `options.append` is true. `Context/#newResponse` performs the second merge path: headers arriving via `arg.headers` are copied with `responseHeaders.append(key, value)` when `key === 'set-cookie'` (otherwise `.set()`), and array-valued `HeaderRecord` entries are delete-then-re-append.

### Header name types (`src/utils/headers.ts` — types only, no merge code)
| Symbol | Kind | Location | Contains |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RequestHeader` | Type alias | `src/utils/headers.ts:7-263` | `'Set-Cookie'` at line 224, `'Set-Cookie2'` at 225 |

| `AcceptHeader` | Type alias | `src/utils/headers.ts:344-351` | — |
| `CustomHeader` | Type alias | `src/utils/headers.ts:354` | — |

Note: there is **no shared "mergeHeaders"/"appendHeader" helper** anywhere. `find_symbol("appendHeader")` returns nothing, and the only `setHeaders` function is `src/middleware/secure-headers/secure-headers.ts:336-340` (unrelated to cookies). The merging is inline in `Context/res[1]` and `Context/#newResponse`.
